about: Front-end pattern corpus: small synthetic pages, one common way to build a front end each, with the observation facts extension/page.js should report on them. test/patterns.test.js loads every page into headless Chromium with the real page script and turns each check into a test; a check with `finding` is a known gap, run as a todo whose message names it. Check fields: `steps` run first in order ({click: label}, {scroll: up|down}, {fill: label, text}, {wait: ms}); `level` is the capability level the page script is given (read-only, reversible, interactive; default read-only); `expect` holds the facts: overlay (null, or a subset of the observation's overlay), consent (true/false), text / textAbsent (viewport text), blocks / blocksAbsent (any block's text), controls / controlsAbsent (control labels, substring), marked (labels of controls inside an overlay), closers (labels of an overlay's close controls), frameControls (labels of controls inside a frame), fillKept (the last fill), warnings.

patterns.exercises: ARIA modal (role=dialog, aria-modal) in a dimming wrapper, newsletter nag closed by a × button
promo overlay made of plain divs (no dialog role) over a separate backdrop element; only a backdrop click closes it
native <dialog> opened with showModal(), sign-up nag with no close control; Escape closes it
non-modal bottom sheet asking to install the app, closed by "Not now"
the live Booking.com shape: a cookie banner and a membership modal ("Sign in, save money") at once; reject the cookies first, then dismiss the modal by its aria-labelled icon button
a task dialog (an address form with a close X): reported as kind task, never dismissed, its controls not demoted
an age gate with a close X: the user answers it, never dismissed
a fixed header with navigation and a Sign in link: page chrome, never an overlay
an infinite list: an IntersectionObserver appends 10 items when a sentinel scrolls into view, up to 40
a "Load more" button appending the next items in place
numbered page links with Previous (disabled span) and Next
ARIA tabs with hidden inactive panels and a closed <details> accordion

text: A light shoe for rocky trails

checks.finding: FINDING: the text of hidden tab panels and closed <details> is in the DOM but nowhere in the observation, not even marked hidden, so a reader cannot tell which tab holds the answer before clicking each one

patterns.exercises: open shadow roots (text, a button, a nested component, slotted light DOM) and a closed shadow root

checks.finding: FINDING: a closed shadow root cannot be read by a page script (by design); its text never reaches the observation

patterns.exercises: a same-origin iframe (table and link) and a srcdoc iframe
a virtualized list in its own scroll container (the window does not scroll): only rows in view are in the DOM
framework-controlled inputs: a React-style value tracker and a field that only takes trusted keyboard input

checks.finding: FINDING: a field that accepts only trusted (user) keyboard input reverts every synthetic fill; the page script reports fill_not_kept correctly but has no way to type trusted keys (that needs the debugger's Input.insertText)

patterns.exercises: an ARIA combobox opening a div listbox, and a role-less div dropdown

checks.finding: FINDING: a role-less div with only a click handler and cursor: pointer is not a control; a div dropdown cannot be opened or chosen from

patterns.exercises: a read-only date field opening a non-modal picker dialog with a grid of day buttons named by number only: the picker is not a blocking overlay (and as a grid it would be a task dialog), and its days get calendar names

a contact form in a role=dialog modal that a button opens: fields named only by placeholder and name, a spam-trap field placed off the page, and a status line that says sending, then sent, then the modal closes
